Description: John Doe was arrested and charged with burglary for allegedly breaking into a convenience store at night when the store was closed, using a stone to smash a side window. The store owner who has run the store for over 30 years reported that several hundred dollars were taken from the cash register. He described the break-in as 'devastating', not just financially but emotionally, as the store is both his livelihood and a cornerstone of the neighborhood. Doe’s annual income is $82,000.
ProsecutorStatement: Doe has a prior misdemeanor conviction from two years ago for stealing an iPhone that was left unattended on a Starbucks counter. Due to the nature of the current charge and previous criminal record, Doe poses a risk of re-offending and flight.
AttorneyStatement: Doe has a stable residence, lives locally with family, and is employed part-time. Given Doe’s stable living arrangements, strong family support, and employment status, he will attend all court appearances and poses minimal flight risk.
